pois.name: Haraldstøtta
pois.intro: Haraldshaugen is a national monument in Haugesund, Norway. The monument was erected during the millennial celebration of Norway's unification into one kingdom under the rule of King Harald Fairhair.

pois.name: Tonjer fyr
pois.intro: Le phare de Sørhaugøy est un feu côtier situé sur la petite île de Sørhaugøy (archipel de Vibrandsøy au large de la commune de Haugesund, dans le Comté de Rogaland. Il est géré par l'administration côtière norvégienne.

pois.name: Til minne om de som omkom ved Alexsander L. Kielland's Forlis
pois.intro: Alexander L. Kielland was a Norwegian semi-submersible drilling rig that, on 27 March 1980, capsized in the Ekofisk oil field in the North Sea, killing 123 people. The capsize was the worst disaster in Norwegian waters since the Second World War.

pois.name: Haugesund billedgalleri
pois.intro: The Haugesund Art Gallery stands in the north part of Haugesund with a view of the city park and rose garden. The art museum goes back to the Haugesund Art Society, founded in 1913.

pois.name: Grønhaug
pois.intro: Der Grønhaug ist ein großer Grabhügel mit einem Schiffsgrab, etwa einen Kilometer nördlich von Avaldsnes auf Karmøy im norwegischen Fylke Rogaland. Der Hügel wurde 1902 von Haakon Shetelig untersucht.

pois.name: Avaldsnes kirke
pois.intro: Avaldsnes Church is a parish church of the Church of Norway in Karmøy Municipality in Rogaland county, Norway.

pois.name: Skapåbar
pois.description: Here they serve coffee, alcohol and food. There are conserts and dj's in weekends.

pois.name: Oasen storsenter
pois.intro: Oasen Storsenter is a shopping centre in Norheim in Karmøy Municipality, Norway. In 2014 it had a turnover of 688 million Norwegian kroner.
